description: Start granting one product access to one account: gmail (its own gmail.modify grant), calendar, editors (Docs, Sheets, Slides), drive (Drive's one grant), tasks (Google Tasks), contacts (contacts, saved addresses and a Workspace directory, read only) or meet (Meet records and transcripts, read only). Returns the URL to open in a browser, where the user approves as the account named. The redirect then fails to load; pass the URL it tried to complete_consent within 15 minutes. No token ever leaves the server.

account.description: The account label, as list_accounts names it.

grant.description: Gmail only: the grant to consent. modify is the only one this server holds.

name: begin_consent
title: Begin a Google consent
